import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Call

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Correctness of the compiled machine

The semantics of a register-tape program (`Complexity.LogProg.rstep`): ordinary nodes take
their machine step, a call node asks an oracle about the virtual input of the call
(`Complexity.LogProg.vword` of `Complexity.LogProg.callSegs`) and continues in its `yes` or
`no` state with the input head back on the first cell. If the deciders answer the oracle
cleanly, the compiled machine (`Complexity.LogProg.compileTM`) computes what the program
computes (`Complexity.LogProg.compile_correct`), in space bounded by the program's register
ranges plus the deciders' space (`Complexity.LogProg.compile_space`).

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.tapeWord` — the word stored on a register tape.
* `Complexity.LogProg.rstep` — one step of a program, calls being atomic oracle questions.
* `Complexity.LogProg.CallOK` — the precondition of one call, required at every step
  along the run by the compilation theorems' `hcalls` hypotheses.
* `Complexity.LogProg.compileFinTM` — the compiled machine as a bundled finite machine.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.compile_correct` — the compiled machine halts with the program's
  output, all heads in the given ranges at all times; `compile_correct_from` is its form
  from an arbitrary program configuration.
* `Complexity.LogProg.compile_space` — its space usage is at most the sum of the register
  ranges plus `kD (2B + 1)`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3, proof of Lemma 4.17.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

variable {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- The word stored on a register tape (from cell `0`; `[]` if the tape is not of this
shape). -/
noncomputable def tapeWord (f : ℤ → Option Bool) : List Bool :=
  open Classical in if h : ∃ w, f = FinTM.bufferTape w then h.choose else []

/-- A stored word is read back. -/
lemma tapeWord_bufferTape (w : List Bool) : tapeWord (FinTM.bufferTape w) = w := by
  have h : ∃ w', FinTM.bufferTape w = FinTM.bufferTape w' := ⟨w, rfl⟩
  unfold tapeWord
  rw [dif_pos h]
  have hspec := h.choose_spec
  -- `bufferTape` is injective
  apply List.ext_getElem?
  intro i
  have := congrFun hspec (i : ℤ)
  simpa [FinTM.bufferTape] using this.symm

/-- The register words of a program configuration. -/
noncomputable def regWords (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (r : Fin m) : List Bool := tapeWord (c.workTapes r)

/-- **One step of a register-tape program**: an ordinary node takes its machine step; a call
node asks `oracle` (decider `cs.dec`) about its virtual input and moves to `yes` or `no`,
with the input head on the first cell. -/
noncomputable def rstep (P : RProg m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) : Cfg m Bool Λ x :=
  match c.state with
  | none => c
  | some l =>
    match P.call l with
    | none => P.tm.step c
    | some cs =>
      { c with
        state := some (if oracle cs.dec (vword (callSegs cs x (regWords c))) then cs.yes
          else cs.no),
        inputPos := 1 }

/-- The program run: `n` steps of `rstep`. -/
noncomputable def rrun (P : RProg m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (n : ℕ) : Cfg m Bool Λ x :=
  (rstep P oracle)^[n] c

/-- Running a register-tape program `n + 1` steps is one more step after `n` steps. -/
lemma rrun_succ (P : RProg m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x)
    (n : ℕ) : rrun P oracle c (n + 1) = rstep P oracle (rrun P oracle c n) := by
  simp [rrun, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

/-- The preconditions of a call at configuration `c` (if `c` is at a call node): distinct
argument registers holding words with their heads at the origin and within the register
ranges, input head on the first cell, and a decider answering the oracle cleanly within head
range `B`. -/
def CallOK (P : RProg m d Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (lo hi : Fin m → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ l cs, c.state = some l → P.call l = some cs →
    cs.args.Nodup ∧ c.inputPos.val = 1 ∧
    (∀ r ∈ cs.args, c.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (regWords c r) ∧ c.workTapePos r = 0 ∧
      lo r ≤ -1 ∧ ((regWords c r).length : ℤ) ≤ hi r) ∧
    CleanRun D (q0 cs.dec) (vword (callSegs cs x (regWords c)))
      (oracle cs.dec (vword (callSegs cs x (regWords c)))) B

/-- **Correctness of the compiled machine, from any program configuration.** If the program
runs `N` steps from `c`, its register heads stay in `[lo r, hi r]`, and every call along the
way meets its preconditions, then the compiled machine, started on the seam of `c`, reaches
the seam of the program configuration after `N` steps, and at every time its register heads
are in `[lo r, hi r]` and its decider heads in `[-B, B]`. (`compile_correct` is the case of
the initial configuration; the general form is used to splice compiled runs between
nondeterministic choices.)

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the program run, keeping the compiled machine on the seam
(`Complexity.LogProg.seam`) of the program configuration: ordinary steps are simulated in
lockstep (`step_seam_prog`), calls by `call_run`. -/
theorem compile_correct_from (P : RProg m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD)
    (q0 : Fin d → SD) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (lo hi : Fin m → ℤ) (B : ℕ)
    (c₀ : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (N : ℕ)
    (hbox : ∀ t ≤ N, ∀ r, lo r ≤ (rrun P oracle c₀ t).workTapePos r ∧
      (rrun P oracle c₀ t).workTapePos r ≤ hi r)
    (hcalls : ∀ t < N, CallOK P D q0 oracle lo hi B (rrun P oracle c₀ t)) :
    ∃ T, (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c₀) T = seam (rrun P oracle c₀ N) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ T, (∀ r, lo r ≤ ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c₀)
          t).workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r) ∧
          ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c₀) t).workTapePos
            (Fin.castAdd kD r) ≤ hi r) ∧
        ∀ i, |((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c₀) t).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd m i)| ≤ B := by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨0, by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]; rfl, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
    refine ⟨fun r => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
    · have := hbox 0 le_rfl r
      simpa [seam, rrun] using this
    · simp [seam]
  | succ N ih =>
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTb⟩ := ih (fun t ht => hbox t (by omega)) (fun t ht => hcalls t (by omega))
    set c := rrun P oracle c₀ N with hc
    have hbN := hbox N (by omega)
    have hbN1 := hbox (N + 1) le_rfl
    rw [rrun_succ, ← hc] at hbN1 ⊢
    -- one program step from `c`
    have hstep : ∃ T', (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c) T' = seam (rstep P oracle c) ∧
        ∀ t ≤ T', (∀ r, lo r ≤ ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c) t).workTapePos
            (Fin.castAdd kD r) ∧ ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c) t).workTapePos
              (Fin.castAdd kD r) ≤ hi r) ∧
          ∀ i, |((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c) t).workTapePos (Fin.natAdd m i)| ≤ B := by
      cases hs : c.state with
      | none =>
        refine ⟨0, by simp [rstep, hs], fun t ht => ?_⟩
        obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
        exact ⟨fun r => by simpa [seam] using hbN r, fun i => by simp [seam]⟩
      | some l =>
        cases hcl : P.call l with
        | none =>
          have hst := step_seam_prog P l₀ D q0 c l hs hcl
          have hr : rstep P oracle c = P.tm.step c := by simp [rstep, hs, hcl]
          refine ⟨1, by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one, hr]; exact hst, fun t ht => ?_⟩
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
          · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
            exact ⟨fun r => by simpa [seam] using hbN r, fun i => by simp [seam]⟩
          · obtain rfl : t = 1 := by omega
            rw [show (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c) 1 =
              (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c) from MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one _ _, hst, ← hr]
            exact ⟨fun r => by simpa [seam] using hbN1 r, fun i => by simp [seam]⟩
        | some cs =>
          obtain ⟨hnd, hin, hargs, hclean⟩ := hcalls N (by omega) l cs hs hcl
          obtain ⟨T', hb', hr'⟩ := call_run P l₀ D q0 hs hcl (fun r hr => (hargs r hr).1)
            (fun r hr => (hargs r hr).2.1) hnd hin _ B hclean
          have hr : rstep P oracle c = { c with
              state := some (if oracle cs.dec (vword (callSegs cs x (regWords c))) then cs.yes
                else cs.no), inputPos := 1 } := by simp [rstep, hs, hcl]
          refine ⟨T', by rw [hr]; exact hr', fun t ht => ⟨fun r => ?_, (hb' t ht).2⟩⟩
          obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (hb' t ht).1 r
          beta_reduce at h1 h2
          by_cases hrm : r ∈ cs.args
          · obtain ⟨-, -, hlo, hhi⟩ := hargs r hrm
            have := h2 hrm
            constructor <;> omega
          · rw [h1 hrm]; exact hbN r
    obtain ⟨T', hT', hTb'⟩ := hstep
    refine ⟨T + T', by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hT, hT'], ?_⟩
    apply runFrom_forall_append (Q := fun g =>
      (∀ r, lo r ≤ g.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r) ∧ g.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r) ≤ hi r) ∧
        ∀ i, |g.workTapePos (Fin.natAdd m i)| ≤ B) hTb
    rw [hT]
    exact hTb'


/-- **Correctness of the compiled machine.** If the program halts after `N` steps with
output `w`, its register heads stay in `[lo r, hi r]`, and every call along the way meets
its preconditions, then the compiled machine halts with output `w`, and at every time its
register heads are in `[lo r, hi r]` and its decider heads in `[-B, B]`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the program run, keeping the compiled machine on the seam
(`Complexity.LogProg.seam`) of the program configuration: ordinary steps are simulated in
lockstep (`step_seam_prog`), calls by `call_run`. -/
theorem compile_correct (P : RProg m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD)
    (q0 : Fin d → SD) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (lo hi : Fin m → ℤ) (B : ℕ)
    (N : ℕ)
    (hbox : ∀ t ≤ N, ∀ r, lo r ≤ (rrun P oracle (Cfg.init l₀ x) t).workTapePos r ∧
      (rrun P oracle (Cfg.init l₀ x) t).workTapePos r ≤ hi r)
    (hcalls : ∀ t < N, CallOK P D q0 oracle lo hi B (rrun P oracle (Cfg.init l₀ x) t)) :
    ∃ T, (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).initCfg x) T =
        seam (rrun P oracle (Cfg.init l₀ x) N) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ T, (∀ r, lo r ≤ ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).initCfg x)
          t).workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r) ∧
          ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).initCfg x) t).workTapePos
            (Fin.castAdd kD r) ≤ hi r) ∧
        ∀ i, |((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).initCfg x) t).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd m i)| ≤ B := by
  have h := compile_correct_from P l₀ D q0 oracle lo hi B (Cfg.init l₀ x) N hbox hcalls
  rw [seam_init]
  exact h

/-- The space used up to time `T` is bounded by the sizes of ranges containing every head
at every time up to `T`. -/
lemma spaceUsed_le_of_ranges {K : ℕ} {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM K Bool S)
    (c : Cfg K Bool S x) (T : ℕ) (lo hi : Fin K → ℤ)
    (h : ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ i, lo i ≤ (tm.runFrom c t).workTapePos i ∧
      (tm.runFrom c t).workTapePos i ≤ hi i) :
    tm.spaceUsed c T ≤ ∑ i, (hi i - lo i + 1).toNat := by
  unfold MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  have hsub : tm.visitedByTapeHead c T i ⊆ Finset.Icc (lo i) (hi i) := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at hz
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact h t (by omega) i
  refine (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [Int.card_Icc]
  congr 1
  ring

/-- The compiled machine as a bundled finite machine. -/
def compileFinTM [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] [Fintype SD] [DecidableEq SD]
    (P : RProg m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) : FinTM Bool where
  k := m + kD
  State := CSt Λ SD m
  tm := compileTM P l₀ D q0

/-- **The compiled machine computes what the program computes, in the program's space plus
the deciders' space**: if the program halts after `N` steps with output `w`, register heads
in `[lo r, hi r]`, and all calls meet their preconditions with decider head range `B`, then
the compiled machine halts on `x` with output `w`, having visited at most
`∑ r (hi r - lo r + 1) + kD (2B + 1)` work cells.

**Proof sketch.** `compile_correct` gives the halting time and the head ranges;
`spaceUsed_le_of_ranges` turns ranges into space, the register tapes and the decider tapes
being the two blocks of `Fin (m + kD)`. -/
theorem compile_space [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] [Fintype SD] [DecidableEq SD]
    (P : RProg m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (lo hi : Fin m → ℤ) (B N : ℕ) (w : List Bool)
    (hhalt : (rrun P oracle (Cfg.init l₀ x) N).state = none)
    (hout : (rrun P oracle (Cfg.init l₀ x) N).output = w)
    (hbox : ∀ t ≤ N, ∀ r, lo r ≤ (rrun P oracle (Cfg.init l₀ x) t).workTapePos r ∧
      (rrun P oracle (Cfg.init l₀ x) t).workTapePos r ≤ hi r)
    (hcalls : ∀ t < N, CallOK P D q0 oracle lo hi B (rrun P oracle (Cfg.init l₀ x) t)) :
    ∃ T, (compileFinTM P l₀ D q0).ComputesInTime x w T ∧
      (compileFinTM P l₀ D q0).tm.spaceUsed ((compileFinTM P l₀ D q0).tm.initCfg x) T ≤
        ∑ r, (hi r - lo r + 1).toNat + kD * (2 * B + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTb⟩ := compile_correct P l₀ D q0 oracle lo hi B N hbox hcalls
  refine ⟨T, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [FinTM.computesInTime_iff]
    change ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).initCfg x) T).state = none ∧
      ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).initCfg x) T).output = w
    rw [hT]
    exact ⟨by show Option.map _ _ = none; rw [hhalt]; rfl, by show _ = w; exact hout⟩
  · change (compileTM P l₀ D q0).spaceUsed ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).initCfg x) T ≤ _
    have := spaceUsed_le_of_ranges (compileTM P l₀ D q0) ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).initCfg x) T
      (Fin.append lo (fun _ => -(B : ℤ))) (Fin.append hi (fun _ => (B : ℤ))) (by
        intro t ht i
        refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
        · simpa using (hTb t ht).1 r
        · have := (hTb t ht).2 j
          simp only [Fin.append_right]
          rw [abs_le] at this
          exact this)
    refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
    simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    omega

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.MARMCompile
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.DTIME
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Memory register machines decide in exponential time

The run theorem for memory register machines (`Complexity.LogProg.marm_run`): if the
abstract machine answers `b`, its registers of at most `W` binary digits and its memory head
in `[-P, P]`, then the compiled machine (`Complexity.LogProg.mcompileTM`) answers `b`, every
head staying in its range. The time bound is then a configuration count
(`Complexity.LogProg.runFrom_count_eq`), as for space-bounded machines
([AB09, §4.1.1, proof of Theorem 4.2]): a halting deterministic run never repeats a
configuration. The memory tape is not small, but it only grows — its only symbol is `true`,
and `true` is never overwritten — so along the run its contents are determined by its number
of `true` cells: two configurations of the run with the same small tapes, the same heads
and the same number of memory `1`s are equal. Hence the time is at most
`2 ^ O(W + log n) · P²` (`Complexity.LogProg.marm_dtime`), whatever the number of abstract
steps.

This is infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1.1, Theorem 4.2], not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.MGuard` — the guard of the run theorem.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.marm_run` — the run theorem.
* `Complexity.LogProg.runFrom_count_eq` — a run whose last tape only grows, with heads in
  bounded ranges, halts within the count of its configurations.
* `Complexity.LogProg.marm_dtime` — a correct memory register machine calling logspace
  deciders runs in time `2 ^ O(W + log n) · (P + 1)²`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, Claim 4.4, Theorem 4.2.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

/-! ## The run theorem -/

section Run

variable {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- The guard of the run theorem: the preconditions of the step (`Pre` of the deterministic
part), register values of at most `W` binary digits (counting one increment), and the memory
head in `[-P, P]`. -/
def MGuard (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD)
    (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B W P : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (c : MConf m Λ) : Prop :=
  Pre (A.detPart false) oracle D q0 B x c.1 ∧
    (∀ r, ((Nat.bits (c.1.2.1 r + 1)).length : ℤ) ≤ W) ∧ |c.2.2| ≤ P

/-- **The run theorem for memory register machines.** If, from `(l, v)` with memory `(M, p)`,
the abstract machine halts after `N` steps with answer `b`, every configuration before
satisfying `MGuard`, then the compiled machine, from the compiled configuration having written
`out`, halts with output `out ++ [b]`, staying in the box (`MBox`).

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `N`. A register step is `mdet_live` or `mdet_halt`; a memory
step is one compiled step (`mmem_step`). The runs are concatenated
(`runFrom_forall_append`). -/
theorem marm_run (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B W P : ℕ) :
    ∀ (N : ℕ) (l : Λ) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool) (b : Bool),
      (mrun A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) N).1.1 = none →
      (mrun A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) N).1.2.2 = some b →
      (∀ t < N, MGuard A oracle D q0 B W P x (mrun A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) t)) →
      ∃ T, ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) T).state = none ∧
        ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) T).output = out ++ [b] ∧
        ∀ t ≤ T, MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) t) := by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero => intro l v M p out b h1; simp [mrun] at h1
  | succ N ih =>
    intro l v M p out b h1 h2 hg
    obtain ⟨hp, hw, hP⟩ := hg 0 (by omega)
    simp only [mrun, Function.iterate_zero, id] at hp hw hP
    rw [mrun_succ] at h1 h2
    have hg' : ∀ c', mstep A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) = c' →
        ∀ t < N, MGuard A oracle D q0 B W P x (mrun A oracle x c' t) := by
      intro c' hc t ht
      have := hg (t + 1) (by omega)
      rwa [mrun_succ, hc] at this
    -- a segment to a compiled configuration followed by a halting run
    have compose : ∀ (S : ℕ) (C' : Cfg (m + kD + 1) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) x),
        (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) S = C' →
        (∀ t ≤ S, MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) t)) →
        (∃ T', ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom C' T').state = none ∧
          ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom C' T').output = out ++ [b] ∧
          ∀ t ≤ T', MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom C' t)) →
        ∃ T, ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) T).state = none ∧
          ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) T).output = out ++ [b] ∧
          ∀ t ≤ T, MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) t) := by
      rintro S C' hS hbS ⟨T', e1, e2, e3⟩
      refine ⟨S + T', by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hS]; exact e1,
        by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hS]; exact e2, runFrom_forall_append hbS ?_⟩
      rw [hS]; exact e3
    cases hA : A l with
    | det i =>
      rcases astep_cases (x := x) (A.detPart false) oracle l v none with ⟨l', v', hs⟩ | ⟨b₀, hs⟩
      · have hm : mstep A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) = ((some l', v', none), (M, p)) := by
          rw [mstep_det hA false, hs]
        rw [hm] at h1 h2
        obtain ⟨S, hS, hbS⟩ := mdet_live A l₀ oracle D q0 B W P l l' v v' M p out hs hp hw hP
        exact compose S _ hS hbS (ih l' v' M p out b h1 h2 (hg' _ hm))
      · have hm : mstep A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) = ((none, v, some b₀), (M, p)) := by
          rw [mstep_det hA false, hs]
        rw [hm, mrun_halted] at h2
        simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h2
        subst h2
        exact mdet_halt A l₀ oracle D q0 B W P l hA v M p out b₀ hs hp hw hP
    | _ =>
      obtain ⟨l', M', p', hm, hstep⟩ := mmem_step A l₀ oracle D q0 (x := x) (l := l)
        (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem]) v M p out
      rw [hm] at h1 h2
      refine compose 1 _ (by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one,
        hstep]) (fun t ht => ?_) (ih l' v M' p' out b h1 h2 (hg' _ hm))
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
      · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
        exact mbox_mseam W B P l v M p out hP
      · obtain rfl : t = 1 := by omega
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one, hstep]
        cases N with
        | zero => simp [mrun] at h1
        | succ N =>
          exact mbox_mseam W B P l' v M' p' out (hg' _ hm 0 (by omega)).2.2

end Run

/-! ## Counting configurations with a growing tape -/

section Count

variable {K : ℕ} {St : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- A machine whose transitions write on the last tape only `true` (or nothing) changes each
cell of that tape at most into `true`. -/
lemma step_last_cell (tm : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool St)
    (hwrite : ∀ q a w, ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = none ∨
      ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = some (some true))
    (c : Cfg (K + 1) Bool St x) (z : ℤ) :
    (tm.step c).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = c.workTapes (Fin.last K) z ∨
      (tm.step c).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true := by
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  cases hs : c.state with
  | none => exact Or.inl rfl
  | some q =>
    simp only [Action.apply]
    rcases hwrite q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols with h | h
    · left; simp only [h]
    · simp only [h]
      by_cases hz : z = c.workTapePos (Fin.last K)
      · subst hz; right; simp
      · left; simp [Function.update_of_ne hz]

/-- Along a run from initialization, the last tape holds only blanks and `true`s, and a
`true` stays.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the time, by `step_last_cell`. -/
lemma last_tape_run (tm : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool St)
    (hwrite : ∀ q a w, ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = none ∨
      ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = some (some true)) :
    (∀ t z, (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = none ∨
      (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true) ∧
    ∀ t t', t ≤ t' → ∀ z, (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true →
      (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t').workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true := by
  refine ⟨fun t => ?_, fun t t' htt' z hz => ?_⟩
  · induction t with
    | zero => intro z; left; rfl
    | succ t ih =>
      intro z
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
      rcases step_last_cell tm hwrite (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t) z with h | h
      · rw [h]; exact ih z
      · exact Or.inr h
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, t' = t + k := ⟨t' - t, by omega⟩
    induction k with
    | zero => exact hz
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
      rcases step_last_cell tm hwrite (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) (t + k)) z with h | h
      · rw [h]; exact ih (by omega)
      · exact h

open MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount in
/-- **A run whose last tape only grows halts within its configuration count.** If the
transitions of `tm` write on the last tape only `true`, and the run from initialization has
halted by time `T` with every head of the other tapes in `[-B, B]` and the head of the last
tape in `[-P, P]` up to then, then the run is already at its final configuration at time
`(|St| + 1) (n + 2) 3 ^ (K (2B + 1)) (2B + 1) ^ K (2P + 1) (2P + 2)`.

**Proof sketch.** Before the first halting time no core repeats (`core_injOn`). Code a
configuration by its state, input position, the other tapes on `[-B, B]`, the heads, and the
number of `true` cells of the last tape in `[-P, P]`; nonblank cells lie in the head ranges
(`mem_visited_of_ne_none`). Along the run the last tape only grows (`last_tape_run`), so of
two times, the earlier tape is contained in the later; with equal counts they are equal. So
the code is injective before the halting time, which is therefore at most the number of
codes. -/
theorem runFrom_count_eq [Fintype St] (tm : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool St) (B P T : ℕ)
    (hwrite : ∀ q a w, ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = none ∨
      ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = some (some true))
    (hT : (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) T).state = none)
    (hbox : ∀ t ≤ T, (∀ i : Fin K, |(tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos i.castSucc| ≤ B) ∧
      |(tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos (Fin.last K)| ≤ P) :
    tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) ((Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) *
      (2 * B + 1) ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2))) = tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) T := by
  classical
  set run := fun t => tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t with hrun
  obtain ⟨T₀, hT0T, hmin, hfirst⟩ :=
    MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt tm (tm.initCfg x) hT
  have hT0 : (run T₀).state = none := (congrArg Cfg.state hfirst).trans hT
  obtain ⟨hcells, hmono⟩ := last_tape_run (x := x) tm hwrite
  -- nonblank cells lie in the head ranges
  have hwin : ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ (i : Fin (K + 1)) (z : ℤ), (run t).workTapes i z ≠ none →
      ∃ t' ≤ t, (run t').workTapePos i = z := by
    intro t ht i z hz
    have := MultiTapeTM.mem_visited_of_ne_none tm x t i z hz
    exact (MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff (tm := tm) (tm.initCfg x) t i z).mp this
  have hwinS : ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ (i : Fin K) (z : ℤ), (run t).workTapes i.castSucc z ≠ none →
      |z| ≤ B := by
    intro t ht i z hz
    obtain ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩ := hwin t ht _ z hz
    exact (hbox t' (by omega)).1 i
  have hwinL : ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ z : ℤ, (run t).workTapes (Fin.last K) z ≠ none → |z| ≤ P := by
    intro t ht z hz
    obtain ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩ := hwin t ht _ z hz
    exact (hbox t' (by omega)).2
  -- the code
  let cnt : ℕ → Finset ℤ := fun t =>
    (Finset.Icc (-(P : ℤ)) P).filter fun z => (run t).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true
  have hcnt : ∀ t, (cnt t).card ≤ 2 * P + 1 := by
    intro t
    refine (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
  let code : ℕ → Option St × Fin (x.length + 2) × (Fin K → Fin (2 * B + 1) → Option Bool) ×
      (Fin K → Fin (2 * B + 1)) × Fin (2 * P + 1) × Fin (2 * P + 2) := fun t =>
    ((run t).state, (run t).inputPos,
      fun i j => (run t).workTapes i.castSucc ((j : ℤ) - B),
      fun i => posCode B ((run t).workTapePos i.castSucc),
      posCode P ((run t).workTapePos (Fin.last K)),
      ⟨(cnt t).card, by have := hcnt t; omega⟩)
  -- equal codes at two times give equal cores
  have hcore : ∀ a b, a ≤ b → b ≤ T → code a = code b → core (run a) = core (run b) := by
    intro a b hab hb h
    simp only [code, Prod.mk.injEq, Fin.mk.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨hs, hi, hw, hp, hpl, hc⟩ := h
    simp only [core_eq, Prod.mk.injEq]
    refine ⟨hs, hi, ?_, ?_⟩
    · funext i z
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · -- the memory tape
        have hsub : cnt a ⊆ cnt b := by
          intro z hz
          simp only [cnt, Finset.mem_filter] at hz ⊢
          exact ⟨hz.1, hmono a b hab z hz.2⟩
        have heq : cnt a = cnt b := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (le_of_eq hc.symm)
        by_cases hz : |z| ≤ P
        · have hzI : z ∈ Finset.Icc (-(P : ℤ)) P := by
            rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; rw [abs_le] at hz; exact hz
          have hiff : (run a).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true ↔
              (run b).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = some true := by
            have := congrArg (fun s => z ∈ s) heq
            simpa [cnt, hzI] using this
          rcases hcells a z with ha | ha <;> rcases hcells b z with hb' | hb'
          · rw [ha, hb']
          · exact absurd (hiff.mpr hb') (by rw [ha]; simp)
          · exact absurd (hiff.mp ha) (by rw [hb']; simp)
          · rw [ha, hb']
        · have h1 : (run a).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = none := by
            by_contra hne; exact hz (hwinL a (by omega) z hne)
          have h2 : (run b).workTapes (Fin.last K) z = none := by
            by_contra hne; exact hz (hwinL b hb z hne)
          rw [h1, h2]
      · by_cases hz : |z| ≤ B
        · have := congrFun (congrFun hw j) ⟨(z + B).toNat, by rw [abs_le] at hz; omega⟩
          simp only at this
          rwa [show (((z + B).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) - B = z by rw [abs_le] at hz; omega] at this
        · have h1 : (run a).workTapes j.castSucc z = none := by
            by_contra hne; exact hz (hwinS a (by omega) j z hne)
          have h2 : (run b).workTapes j.castSucc z = none := by
            by_contra hne; exact hz (hwinS b hb j z hne)
          rw [h1, h2]
    · funext i
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · exact posCode_injOn P (hbox a (by omega)).2 (hbox b hb).2 hpl
      · exact posCode_injOn B ((hbox a (by omega)).1 j) ((hbox b hb).1 j) (congrFun hp j)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn code (Finset.range T₀ : Set ℕ) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio] at ha hb
    by_contra hne
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h' | h'
    · exact core_injOn tm _ T₀ hT0 hmin h' hb (hcore a b h'.le (by omega) hab)
    · exact core_injOn tm _ T₀ hT0 hmin h' ha (hcore b a h'.le (by omega) hab.symm)
  have hcard : T₀ ≤ (Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) *
      (2 * B + 1) ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2)) := by
    have := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn code (fun a _ => Finset.mem_univ _) hinj
    simp only [Finset.card_range, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_option,
      Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_pi, Finset.prod_const, Fintype.card_bool] at this
    refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm (2 * B + 1) K]
    ring
  calc
    tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) ((Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) *
        (2 * B + 1) ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2))) = tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) T₀ := by
      rw [show (Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) *
          (2 * B + 1) ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2)) =
          T₀ + ((Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) *
          (2 * B + 1) ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2)) - T₀) by omega,
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt _ hT0]
    _ = tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) T := hfirst

end Count

/-! ## From memory register machines to deterministic time -/

section Bridge

/-- The configuration count of `runFrom_count_eq` for the compiled machine, in exponential
form. Here `q + 1` bounds the states, `K` is the number of small tapes, the register heads lie
in `[-1, W]` and the decider heads in `[-B, B]` with `B` the logspace range of the virtual
inputs (`length_callSegs_le`).

**Proof sketch.** The virtual input length `y = 2n + 2 + m (2W + 2)` is below
`2 ^ (logSpace n + W + m + 3)`, so `logSpace y ≤ logSpace n + W + m + 3` and the small-tape
range is at most `(cs + 1) (m + 3) u` with `u = W + logSpace n + 1`. Bound `3 ≤ 2 ^ 2`,
`X ≤ 2 ^ X`, `n + 2 ≤ 2 ^ (logSpace n + 1)` and `(2P + 1) (2P + 2) ≤ 4 (P + 1) ^ 2`, and
collect the exponents. -/
private lemma count_bound (q n K W cs m P : ℕ) :
    (q + 1) * (n + 2) *
        3 ^ (K * (2 * (W + 1 + (cs * logSpace (2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * W + 2)) + 1)) + 1)) *
        (2 * (W + 1 + (cs * logSpace (2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * W + 2)) + 1)) + 1) ^ K *
        ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2)) ≤
      2 ^ ((q + 4 + 3 * K * (2 * ((cs + 1) * (m + 3)) + 1)) * (W + logSpace n + 1)) *
        (P + 1) ^ 2 := by
  set L := logSpace n with hL
  set y := 2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * W + 2) with hy
  have hn : n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ L := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide : 1 < 2) n
  have hW : W + 1 ≤ 2 ^ W := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := W)
  have hm : m + 1 ≤ 2 ^ m := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := m)
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ L := by simp [hL, logSpace]
  -- the logarithm of the virtual input length
  have hylog : logSpace y ≤ L + W + m + 3 := by
    have h1 : y ≤ 4 * ((n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1)) := by
      have a1 : n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1) := by
        calc n + 1 = (n + 1) * 1 * 1 := by ring
          _ ≤ (n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1) := by gcongr <;> omega
      have a2 : m * (W + 1) ≤ (n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1) := by
        calc m * (W + 1) = 1 * (W + 1) * m := by ring
          _ ≤ (n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1) := by gcongr <;> omega
      have e : y = 2 * (n + 1) + 2 * (m * (W + 1)) := by simp only [hy]; ring
      omega
    have h2 : (n + 1) * (W + 1) * (m + 1) ≤ 2 ^ L * 2 ^ W * 2 ^ m := by gcongr
    have h3 : y < 2 ^ (L + W + m + 3) := by
      have : 2 ^ (L + W + m + 3) = 8 * (2 ^ L * 2 ^ W * 2 ^ m) := by
        rw [pow_add, pow_add, pow_add]; ring
      have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ L * 2 ^ W * 2 ^ m :=
        Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.two_pow_pos L) (Nat.two_pow_pos W)) (Nat.two_pow_pos m)
      omega
    have h4 := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (b := 2) (by omega : y ≠ 0) h3
    simp only [logSpace]
    omega
  -- the small-tape range
  set E := (cs + 1) * (m + 3) with hE
  set u := W + L + 1 with hu
  have hu1 : 1 ≤ u := by omega
  have hB : W + 1 + (cs * logSpace y + 1) ≤ E * u := by
    have h1 : cs * logSpace y ≤ cs * (L + W + m + 3) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hylog
    have h2 : L + W + m + 3 ≤ (m + 3) * u := by
      have : (m + 3) * u = u + (m + 2) * u := by ring
      have : m + 2 ≤ (m + 2) * u := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hu1
      omega
    have h3 : (cs + 1) * (L + W + m + 3) ≤ E * u := by
      rw [hE, mul_assoc]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h2
    have : (cs + 1) * (L + W + m + 3) = cs * (L + W + m + 3) + (L + W + m + 3) := by ring
    omega
  set X := 2 * (W + 1 + (cs * logSpace y + 1)) + 1 with hX
  have hXu : X ≤ (2 * E + 1) * u := by
    have : (2 * E + 1) * u = 2 * (E * u) + u := by ring
    omega
  -- the factors
  have f1 : q + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (q + 1) := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := q + 1)).le
  have f2 : n + 2 ≤ 2 ^ (L + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := L); omega
  have f3 : 3 ^ (K * X) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * (K * X)) := by
    calc 3 ^ (K * X) ≤ (2 ^ 2) ^ (K * X) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by decide) _
      _ = 2 ^ (2 * (K * X)) := (pow_mul 2 2 _).symm
  have f4 : X ^ K ≤ 2 ^ (X * K) := by
    rw [pow_mul]; exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := X)).le _
  have f5 : (2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2) ≤ 2 ^ 2 * (P + 1) ^ 2 :=
    calc (2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2) ≤ (2 * P + 2) * (2 * P + 2) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
      _ = 2 ^ 2 * (P + 1) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hexp : (q + 1) + (L + 1) + 2 * (K * X) + X * K + 2 ≤
      (q + 4 + 3 * K * (2 * E + 1)) * u := by
    have g1 : 3 * (K * X) ≤ 3 * K * ((2 * E + 1) * u) := by
      rw [mul_assoc]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hXu)
    have g2 : (q + 4) + L ≤ (q + 4) * u := by
      have g2a : L ≤ (q + 4) * L := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left L (by omega)
      have g2b : (q + 4) * (L + 1) ≤ (q + 4) * u := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
      have g2c : (q + 4) * (L + 1) = (q + 4) * L + (q + 4) := by ring
      omega
    have e : (q + 4 + 3 * K * (2 * E + 1)) * u = (q + 4) * u + 3 * K * ((2 * E + 1) * u) := by
      ring
    have e2 : X * K = K * X := Nat.mul_comm _ _
    omega
  calc (q + 1) * (n + 2) * 3 ^ (K * X) * X ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2))
      ≤ 2 ^ (q + 1) * 2 ^ (L + 1) * 2 ^ (2 * (K * X)) * 2 ^ (X * K) *
          (2 ^ 2 * (P + 1) ^ 2) := by gcongr
    _ = 2 ^ ((q + 1) + (L + 1) + 2 * (K * X) + X * K + 2) * (P + 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [pow_add, pow_add, pow_add, pow_add]; ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ ((q + 4 + 3 * K * (2 * E + 1)) * u) * (P + 1) ^ 2 :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hexp)

variable {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type}

/-- **Memory register machines decide in exponential time.** If, on every input `x`, the
memory register machine `A` (calling deciders for languages in `L`), started at `l₀` with all
registers `0` and a blank memory, answers `x ∈ L` through configurations meeting the syntactic
preconditions, with register values of at most `W |x|` binary digits (counting one increment)
and the memory head in `[-P |x|, P |x|]`, then some machine decides `L` on every input `x`
within `2 ^ (C (W |x| + logSpace |x| + 1)) · (P |x| + 1)²` steps.

**Proof sketch.** As for `arm_decides`: the deciders are collected in a clean bank
(`bank_cleanRun`), whose head ranges on the virtual inputs (of length at most
`2|x| + 2 + m (2W + 2)`, `length_callSegs_le`) are logarithmic. `marm_run` gives a halting
compiled run in the box, and `runFrom_count_eq` (the compiled machine writes only `true` on its
memory tape) bounds its halting time by the configuration count, which `count_bound` puts in
exponential form. -/
theorem marm_dtime {L : Language Bool} [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ)
    (As : Fin d → Language Bool) (hAs : ∀ j, As j ∈ LOGSPACE) (W P : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hcorr : ∀ x, MHalt A (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) x
      (fun c => PreS (A.detPart false) x c.1 ∧
        (∀ r, (Nat.bits (c.1.2.1 r + 1)).length ≤ W x.length) ∧ |c.2.2| ≤ (P x.length : ℤ))
      ((some l₀, fun _ => 0, none), (fun _ => false, 0))
      (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x)) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (C : ℕ), ∀ x, M.ComputesInTime x
      [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x]
      (2 ^ (C * (W x.length + logSpace x.length + 1)) * (P x.length + 1) ^ 2) := by
  classical
  have hc : ∀ j, ∃ (c : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool), M.DecidesInSpace (As j) fun n => c * logSpace n :=
    fun j => hAs j
  let c : Fin d → ℕ := fun j => Classical.choose (hc j)
  let Ms : Fin d → FinTM Bool := fun j => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (hc j))
  have hMs : ∀ j, (Ms j).DecidesInSpace (As j) fun n => c j * logSpace n :=
    fun j => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hc j))
  set cs := ∑ j, c j with hcs
  have hcj : ∀ j, c j ≤ cs := fun j =>
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := c) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  set oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool :=
    fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V with horacle
  set q := Fintype.card (CSt (Λ × Ph) (CleanSt (BankS Ms) (bankK Ms)) m) with hq
  refine ⟨mcompileFinTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms),
    q + 4 + 3 * (m + (bankK Ms + bankK Ms)) * (2 * ((cs + 1) * (m + 3)) + 1), fun x => ?_⟩
  set n := x.length with hn
  set Wn := W n with hWn
  set Pn := P n with hPn
  set B := cs * logSpace (2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * Wn + 2)) + 1 with hB
  obtain ⟨N, h1, h2, hm⟩ := hcorr x
  have hguard : ∀ t < N, MGuard A oracle (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms) B Wn Pn x
      (mrun A oracle x ((some l₀, fun _ => 0, none), (fun _ => false, 0)) t) := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨hps, hbd, hp⟩ := hm t ht
    refine ⟨?_, fun r => by exact_mod_cast hbd r, hp⟩
    generalize hat : (mrun A oracle x ((some l₀, fun _ => 0, none), (fun _ => false, 0)) t).1 =
      a at hps hbd
    rcases a with ⟨_ | l, v, res⟩
    · trivial
    · simp only [Pre]
      cases hA : A.detPart false l with
      | jeq r s' l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | jeqIn r l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | jeqFst r l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | jeqSnd r l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | inc => trivial
      | dec => trivial
      | clr => trivial
      | half => trivial
      | jz => trivial
      | jodd => trivial
      | ret => trivial
      | valP => trivial
      | valQ => trivial
      | call j md args l₁ l₀' =>
      simp only [PreS, hA] at hps
      refine ⟨hps, ?_⟩
      refine cleanRun_mono (bank_cleanRun Ms As (fun j n => c j * logSpace n) hMs j _) ?_
      have hVl := length_callSegs_le (x := x) ⟨j, md, args, l₁, l₀'⟩ Wn (fun r => Nat.bits (v r))
        (fun r => by
          show (Nat.bits (v r)).length ≤ Wn
          have h0 : (Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length ≤ Wn := hbd r
          have hle : (Nat.bits (v r)).length ≤ (Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length :=
            length_bits_mono (by omega)
          omega) hps
      rw [← hn] at hVl
      have hlog : logSpace (vword (callSegs ⟨j, md, args, l₁, l₀'⟩ x
          fun r => Nat.bits (v r))).length ≤ logSpace (2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * Wn + 2)) := by
        simp only [logSpace]
        have := Nat.log_mono_right (b := 2) hVl
        omega
      have hcm : c j * logSpace (vword (callSegs ⟨j, md, args, l₁, l₀'⟩ x
          fun r => Nat.bits (v r))).length ≤ cs * logSpace (2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * Wn + 2)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (hcj j) hlog
      show max _ 1 ≤ B
      exact max_le (hcm.trans (by omega)) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨T, e1, e2, e3⟩ := marm_run (x := x) A l₀ oracle (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms) B Wn Pn N l₀
    (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => false) 0 [] (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x) h1 h2
    hguard
  rw [← mcompileTM_init] at e1 e2 e3
  simp only [List.nil_append] at e2
  have hcount := runFrom_count_eq (K := m + (bankK Ms + bankK Ms)) (x := x)
    (mcompileTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms))
    (Wn + 1 + B) Pn T
    (fun q' a w => by
      simp only [mcompileTM]
      cases mop A q' with
      | none => left; simp [liftAct]
      | some i => cases i <;> simp [memAct])
    e1
    (fun t ht => by
      obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3⟩ := e3 t ht
      refine ⟨fun i => ?_, b3⟩
      refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun k => ?_) i
      · have := b1 r
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> push_cast <;> omega
      · have := b2 k
        rw [abs_le] at this ⊢; constructor <;> push_cast <;> omega)
  rw [FinTM.computesInTime_iff]
  have hb := count_bound q n (m + (bankK Ms + bankK Ms)) Wn cs m Pn
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · show ((mcompileTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)).runFrom
      ((mcompileTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)).initCfg x) _).state = none
    rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le hb, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hcount, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt _ e1]
    exact e1
  · show ((mcompileTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)).runFrom
      ((mcompileTM A l₀ (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms)).initCfg x) _).output = _
    rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le hb, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hcount, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt _ e1]
    exact e2

end Bridge

end Complexity.LogProg
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/WindowClock.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 Seyoon Ragavan. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.WindowRun
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ConfigGraph

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The windowed runner under a configuration-count clock

Host H3 (`machine-library-design.md` §14) in the form `Complexity.space_hierarchy`'s
diagonalizer cites: the windowed runner of `Build/WindowRun.lean` with a clock that it builds
itself, large enough for every configuration of the simulated machine in the window plus the
one extra halt-test round ([AB09, §4.1.1, Claim 4.4]). With it come the bridges from space
bounds to windows: a computation within `s` cells stays in the radius-`s` window; the
configuration count is at most a power of two whose exponent is linear in the record length;
and a halting space-bounded computation is reported `halted` by the windowed run, with its
output's summary tag.

The module is in `SpaceComplexity` because it uses `Turing.FinTM.configBound`
(`SpaceComplexity/ConfigCount.lean`) and the summary tag (`SpaceComplexity/ConfigGraph.lean`),
so that `Build/WindowRun.lean` imports nothing from `SpaceComplexity`.

**Status.** Everything here is proved: the bridges, and `Turing.exists_configWindowRunnerTM`,
whose clock writer, phase host and clear are private to this module.

## Main definitions

None: the module uses existing definitions.

## Main results

* `Turing.FinTM.inWindow_of_spaceUsed_le` — window containment (proved).
* `Turing.windowRun_summary_of_halts` — the windowed run of a halting space-bounded
  computation, with the summary tag (proved).
* `Turing.FinTM.configBound_le_two_pow` — the configuration count is at most a power of two
  (proved).
* `Turing.exists_configWindowRunnerTM` — the windowed runner with its configuration-count
  clock (proved).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, Claim 4.4: the configuration count; §4.1.3,
  Theorem 4.8, whose proof the book assigns to Exercise 4.1. The runner, its clocks and the
  bridges are the repository's refinement of that argument.)
-/

namespace Turing

/-! ### From space bounds to windows -/

/-- **Window containment.** If `M` has visited at most `s` work cells by time `t` on `x`,
then every configuration of its run up to time `t` lies in the radius-`s` window: every head
is within `[-s, s]` and every cell outside it is blank. This is the containment step of
`Complexity.space_hierarchy`'s contradiction, and the hypothesis under which the windowed
runner follows the run. [AB09, §4.1.1, Claim 4.4]

**Proof sketch.** Each tape's visited set has at most `s` cells and is an interval around `0`
(`Turing.MultiTapeTM.abs_pos_lt_card_visited`), so each visited cell has absolute value below
`s`. The head at time `u` is visited, and a nonblank cell at time `u` was visited by then
(`Turing.MultiTapeTM.mem_visited_of_ne_none`), hence by time `t`. -/
theorem FinTM.inWindow_of_spaceUsed_le (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) {t s : ℕ}
    (hs : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s) :
    ∀ u ≤ t, (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).InWindow s := by
  intro u hu
  have hmem : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg x) t i, |z| < (s : ℤ) := by
    intro i z hz
    have hcard : (M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg x) t i).card ≤ s :=
      (M.tm.spaceUsedByTape_le_spaceUsed _ t i).trans hs
    exact (M.tm.abs_pos_lt_card_visited x t i hz).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hcard)
  refine ⟨fun i => (hmem i _ ?_).le, fun i z hz => ?_⟩
  · simp only [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
    exact ⟨u, by omega, rfl⟩
  · by_contra hne
    have hv := M.tm.visitedByTapeHead_mono _ hu i (M.tm.mem_visited_of_ne_none x u i z hne)
    have := hmem i z hv
    omega

/-- **The windowed run of a space-bounded halting computation** (the B6 instance). If `M`
halts on `x` with output `w` by time `t`, having visited at most `s` cells, and `t < N`, then
`N` rounds from `M`'s initial configuration with the empty-output tag `0` report exit
`halted`, the halted configuration of time `t`, and the tag of `w`. With the tag `1` exactly
when `w = [true]` (`Turing.outSummaryCode_eq_one_iff`), this is the verdict the diagonalizer
flips. [AB09, Theorem 4.8 with Exercise 4.1]

**Proof sketch.** Window containment (`Turing.FinTM.inWindow_of_spaceUsed_le`), then
`Turing.windowRun_halted_of_run` with `σ = outSummaryCode ∘ outSummary`, whose compatibility
is `Turing.summaryTag_append`. -/
theorem windowRun_summary_of_halts (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) {w : List Bool}
    {t s N : ℕ} (h : M.ComputesInTime x w t) (hs : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s)
    (hN : t < N) :
    windowRun M.tm s summaryTag N (M.tm.initCfg x) 0 =
      (.halted, M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t, outSummaryCode (outSummary w)) := by
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hout⟩ := (FinTM.computesInTime_iff M x w t).mp h
  have key := windowRun_halted_of_run M.tm s summaryTag (fun u => outSummaryCode (outSummary u))
    summaryTag_append N t (M.tm.initCfg x) hN hhalt (FinTM.inWindow_of_spaceUsed_le M x hs)
  rw [hout] at key
  exact key

/-- **The configuration count is at most a power of two** (the RD-3 gate's check 4):
`configBound M n s ≤ 2 ^ (|Q| + posWidth n + 3 k (2s + 1))`. Its four factors satisfy
`|Q| + 1 ≤ 2^|Q|`, `n + 2 ≤ 2^(posWidth n)`, `3^(k(2s+1)) ≤ 2^(2k(2s+1))` and
`(2s + 1)^k ≤ 2^(k(2s+1))`. A clock word of all `true` digits one longer than the exponent has
value `2^W - 1 > configBound M n s`. [AB09, §4.1.1, Claim 4.4]

**Proof sketch.** Multiply the four factor bounds and collect the powers of two. -/
theorem FinTM.configBound_le_two_pow (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) :
    M.configBound n s ≤
      2 ^ (Fintype.card M.State + posWidth n + 3 * M.k * (2 * s + 1)) := by
  have hQ : Fintype.card M.State + 1 ≤ 2 ^ Fintype.card M.State :=
    Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have hn : n + 2 ≤ 2 ^ posWidth n := record_pos_lt n
  have h3 : 3 ^ (M.k * (2 * s + 1)) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * (M.k * (2 * s + 1))) :=
    calc 3 ^ (M.k * (2 * s + 1)) ≤ 4 ^ (M.k * (2 * s + 1)) :=
          Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by norm_num) _
      _ = 2 ^ (2 * (M.k * (2 * s + 1))) := by
          rw [pow_mul 2 2 (M.k * (2 * s + 1))]
          norm_num
  have hw : (2 * s + 1) ^ M.k ≤ 2 ^ (M.k * (2 * s + 1)) := by
    rw [mul_comm M.k, pow_mul]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le _
  have hsplit : 2 ^ (Fintype.card M.State + posWidth n + 3 * M.k * (2 * s + 1)) =
      2 ^ Fintype.card M.State * 2 ^ posWidth n * 2 ^ (2 * (M.k * (2 * s + 1))) *
        2 ^ (M.k * (2 * s + 1)) := by
    rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  unfold FinTM.configBound
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul hQ hn) h3) hw

/-! ### The runner -/

/-- An all-true binary clock has value one less than the corresponding power of two.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the width, using the binary digit recurrence. -/
private lemma cw_true_value (W : ℕ) :
    Nat.ofDigits 2 ((List.replicate W true).map Bool.toNat) = 2 ^ W - 1 := by
  induction W with
  | zero => simp
  | succ W ih =>
    simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.map_cons, Nat.ofDigits_cons, Bool.toNat_true, ih,
      pow_succ]
    have hp : 0 < 2 ^ W := Nat.pow_pos (by decide)
    omega

/-- The runner's per-round cost is at most a power of two when the position width
fits in the record length. **Proof sketch.** Bound each summand by `2 ^ L`. -/
private lemma cw_round_cost {L n p : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ L) (hn : n + 2 ≤ 2 ^ p) :
    L + n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (L + 1) := by
  have hpow : 2 ^ p ≤ 2 ^ L := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hp
  have hL : L < 2 ^ L := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  rw [pow_succ]
  omega

/-- A constant number of passes over field cells supplies every certified round,
including the extra halt-test round. The layout identities are explicit hypotheses.
**Proof sketch.** Bound the runner cost, configuration count plus one and runner
constant by powers of two. Their combined exponent is strictly below the clock width. -/
private lemma cw_budget {q k n s p L B : ℕ} (C : ℕ)
    (hL : L = k * (2 * s + 1) + p + k + 4) (hn : n + 2 ≤ 2 ^ p)
    (hB : B ≤ 2 ^ (q + p + 3 * k * (2 * s + 1))) :
    C * (B + 1) * (L + n + 1) ≤
      2 ^ ((C + q + 8) * (k * (2 * s + 1) + p + 2)) - 1 := by
  let F := k * (2 * s + 1) + p + 2
  let A := q + p + 3 * k * (2 * s + 1)
  have hk : k ≤ k * (2 * s + 1) := by nlinarith
  have hF : 2 ≤ F := by dsimp [F]; omega
  have hLF : L ≤ 2 * F := by dsimp [F]; omega
  have hA : A ≤ q + 3 * F := by dsimp [A, F]; nlinarith
  have hcost := cw_round_cost (show p ≤ L by omega) hn
  have hC : C ≤ 2 ^ C := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le
  have hBp : B + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (A + 1) := by
    have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ A := Nat.pow_pos (by decide)
    rw [pow_succ]
    change B ≤ 2 ^ A at hB
    omega
  have hprod : C * (B + 1) * (L + n + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (C + (A + 1) + (L + 1)) := by
    rw [pow_add, pow_add]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul hC hBp) hcost
  have hexp : C + (A + 1) + (L + 1) < (C + q + 8) * F := by nlinarith
  have hstrict : 2 ^ (C + (A + 1) + (L + 1)) < 2 ^ ((C + q + 8) * F) :=
    Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by decide) hexp
  exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hprod hstrict)

/-- Linear writer and cleanup costs fit the target's single exponential envelope.
**Proof sketch.** The same power bounds `2 ^ W`, `L + 1` and one; multiply
these three bounds by their nonnegative coefficients and add. -/
private lemma cw_time_bound {c L W : ℕ} (A D : ℕ) (hW : W ≤ c * L) :
    A * (L + 1) + (5 * (2 ^ W - 1) + 2 * W + 3) + (2 * W + 2) + D ≤
      (A + 4 * c + D + 10) * 2 ^ ((A + 4 * c + D + 10) * (L + 1)) := by
  let C := A + 4 * c + D + 10
  let P := 2 ^ (C * (L + 1))
  have hC : 1 ≤ C ∧ c ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; omega
  have hLp : L + 1 ≤ P := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le.trans
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (show L + 1 ≤ C * (L + 1) by nlinarith))
  have hWp : 2 ^ W ≤ P := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide)
    (show W ≤ C * (L + 1) by nlinarith)
  have hP : 1 ≤ P := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by decide)
  have hwrite := Nat.mul_le_mul_left A hLp
  have hlinear := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (4 * c) hLp
  have hdispatch := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (D + 5) hP
  have hsub : 2 ^ W - 1 ≤ 2 ^ W := Nat.sub_le _ _
  change _ ≤ C * P
  dsimp [C]
  nlinarith

/-- A clock of linear width preserves the runner's linear head envelope. -/
private lemma cw_head_bound {c L W : ℕ} (C : ℕ) (hW : W ≤ c * L) :
    C * (L + W + 1) ≤ C * (c + 1) * (L + 1) := by
  calc
    C * (L + W + 1) ≤ C * ((c + 1) * (L + 1)) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left C (by nlinarith)
    _ = C * (c + 1) * (L + 1) := by ring

/-- The field cells of a configuration record exclude its `k + 2` separators.
**Proof sketch.** Subtract the separator count from the published layout length. -/
private lemma cw_field_total {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ)
    (d : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T) :
    ((cfgRecord s d τ).map List.length).sum = k * (2 * s + 1) + posWidth x.length + 2 := by
  have hcount := cfgRecord_length s d τ
  have hne : cfgRecord s d τ ≠ [] := by
    intro h
    rw [h, List.length_nil] at hcount
    omega
  have hlen := joinFields_length (cfgRecord s d τ) hne
  rw [joinFields_cfgRecord_length, recordLength_eq, hcount] at hlen
  omega

/-- The chosen all-true word fits linearly in the record and supplies the runner's
budget for every round up to the configuration count plus one.
**Proof sketch.** Apply the arithmetic budget to the public record-length and
position-width equations, then use the exact all-true clock value. -/
private lemma cw_record_clock (M : FinTM Bool) {T : Type} {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ)
    (d : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (τ : T) (C : ℕ) :
    let c := C + Fintype.card M.State + 8
    let W := c * ((cfgRecord s d τ).map List.length).sum
    W ≤ c * recordLength M.k x.length s ∧
      ∀ N ≤ M.configBound x.length s + 1,
        C * N * (recordLength M.k x.length s + x.length + 1) ≤
          Nat.ofDigits 2 ((List.replicate W true).map Bool.toNat) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [cw_field_total]
  constructor
  · apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
    rw [recordLength_eq]
    omega
  · intro N hN
    rw [cw_true_value]
    have hn : x.length + 2 ≤ 2 ^ posWidth x.length := record_pos_lt x.length
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left C hN)).trans
      (cw_budget C (recordLength_eq M.k x.length s) hn
        (M.configBound_le_two_pow x.length s))

/-- The writer's one-step leaf moves the clock head left onto its delimiter.
The catalog skips past a delimiter; no catalog row stops on that delimiter. -/
private def cw_leftTM {Γ : Type} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Γ Bool where
  q₀ := false
  tr := fun _ _ _ => tapeAction i 0 none .neg true

/-- The delimiter move takes one silent step, keeps the native input position,
and changes only the selected head and control state. -/
private lemma cw_left_run {Γ : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Γ Bool x) (hd : d.state = some false) :
    (cw_leftTM k i).runFrom d 1 =
      { d with state := some true
               workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - 1) } ∧
      (∀ u < 1, ((cw_leftTM k i).runFrom d u).state ≠ some true) := by
  constructor
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one]
    have h := step_of_tapeAction_move (cw_leftTM k i) d i 0 .neg hd rfl
    simpa only [moveInputPos_zero, SignType.coe_neg_one, sub_eq_add_neg] using h
  · intro u hu
    have hu0 : u = 0 := by omega
    rw [hu0, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hd]
    decide

/-- A constant patch reads the constant inside its interval and the original tape outside.
**Proof sketch.** Inside the interval the patch reads the word at a valid offset; outside it
reads the original tape. -/
private lemma cw_patch_rep {Γ : Type} (ct : ℤ → Option Γ) (p : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (e : Γ) (z : ℤ) :
    wordPatch ct p (List.replicate n e) z = if p ≤ z ∧ z < p + n then some e else ct z := by
  by_cases h : p ≤ z ∧ z < p + n
  · rw [if_pos h, wordPatch_of_mem _ _ _ h.1 (by rw [List.length_replicate]; exact h.2),
      ← Int.toNat_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ z - p by omega), FinTM.bufferTape_nat,
      List.getElem?_replicate, if_pos (by omega)]
  · rw [if_neg h, wordPatch_of_not_mem _ _ _ (by rw [List.length_replicate]; exact h)]

/-- The buffer of a constant word. -/
private lemma cw_buffer_rep {Γ : Type} (n : ℕ) (e : Γ) (z : ℤ) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate n e) z = if 0 ≤ z ∧ z < n then some e else none := by
  by_cases h : 0 ≤ z
  · rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg h, FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_replicate]
    by_cases hn : z.toNat < n
    · rw [if_pos hn, if_pos (by omega)]
    · rw [if_neg hn, if_neg (by omega)]
  · rw [FinTM.bufferTape_of_neg _ (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]

/-- Two adjacent constant patches are one: the join of a pass's writes. -/
private lemma cw_join {Γ : Type} (ct : ℤ → Option Γ) (p : ℤ) (e : Γ) (n l : ℕ) :
    wordPatch (wordPatch ct p (List.replicate n e)) (p + n) (List.replicate l e) =
      wordPatch ct p (List.replicate (n + l) e) := by
  have h := wordPatch_append ct p (List.replicate n e) (List.replicate l e)
  rw [List.length_replicate, ← List.replicate_add] at h
  exact h

/-- A mapped copy of one field writes a constant symbol on the destination: the destination
tape becomes the patch of `|w|` copies of `e` at its head. It requires delimiters only on the
source, so it also appends to an existing clock prefix. Up to the exit the source and
destination heads stay within one cell of their intervals, and the other heads are fixed.
**Proof sketch.** Use the framed mapped copy. Every cell inside its write interval has a valid
source index, and the constant merge ignores the old destination value. -/
private lemma cw_copy_constant {Γ : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ}
    (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (e : Γ) (w : List Γ)
    (d : Cfg k Γ SweepPhase x) (hd : d.state = some .sweep)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (copyMapTM k src dst (fun _ => ()) (fun _ _ => e)).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
      { d with state := some .done
               workTapes := fun j q => if j = dst then
                 wordPatch (d.workTapes j) (d.workTapePos j) (List.replicate w.length e) q
                 else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2,
        ((copyMapTM k src dst (fun _ => ()) (fun _ _ => e)).runFrom d t).state ≠
          some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
        if j = src ∨ j = dst then
          ((copyMapTM k src dst (fun _ => ()) (fun _ _ => e)).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
        else ((copyMapTM k src dst (fun _ => ()) (fun _ _ => e)).runFrom d t).workTapePos j =
          d.workTapePos j) := by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := copyMapTM_run_ofCfg src dst hne (fun _ => ()) (fun _ _ => e) w d hd hw
  refine ⟨?_, h₂, h₃⟩
  rw [h₁]
  congr 1
  funext j q
  by_cases hj : j = dst
  · rw [if_pos hj, cw_patch_rep]
    by_cases hq : d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
    · rw [if_pos ⟨hj, hq⟩, if_pos hq]
      have hk : (q - d.workTapePos j).toNat < w.length := by omega
      rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q - d.workTapePos j by omega), FinTM.bufferTape_nat,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem hk]
      rfl
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => hq h.2), if_neg hq]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h => hj h.1), if_neg hj]

/-- Clearing a word patch leaves its tape completely blank when the underlying tape
is blank outside the patch interval. Every other tape, all heads, the native input
position, and the output are preserved. Up to the exit the head stays within one cell of the
interval, and the other heads are fixed.
**Proof sketch.** The patch supplies the clear row's delimited word. The row clears
its interval; outside it, the patch preserves the assumed blank frame. -/
private lemma cw_clear_patch {Γ : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (i : Fin k)
    (w : List Γ) (d : Cfg k Γ SweepPhase x)
    (hb : ∀ q, q < d.workTapePos i ∨ d.workTapePos i + (w.length : ℤ) ≤ q →
      d.workTapes i q = none) :
    let a : Cfg k Γ SweepPhase x :=
      { d with state := some .sweep
               workTapes := fun j q => if j = i then
                 wordPatch (d.workTapes j) (d.workTapePos j) w q else d.workTapes j q }
    (clearTM k i).runFrom a (2 * w.length + 2) =
      { d with state := some .done
               workTapes := fun j q => if j = i then none else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((clearTM k i).runFrom a t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
        if j = i then ((clearTM k i).runFrom a t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
        else ((clearTM k i).runFrom a t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  dsimp only
  let a : Cfg k Γ SweepPhase x :=
    { d with state := some .sweep
             workTapes := fun j q => if j = i then
               wordPatch (d.workTapes j) (d.workTapePos j) w q else d.workTapes j q }
  change (clearTM k i).runFrom a (2 * w.length + 2) = _ ∧
    (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((clearTM k i).runFrom a t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
    (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
      if j = i then ((clearTM k i).runFrom a t).workTapePos j ∈
          Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
      else ((clearTM k i).runFrom a t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)
  have hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      a.workTapes i (a.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p := by
    intro p hp hlen
    dsimp only [a]
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    by_cases hin : 0 ≤ p ∧ p < (w.length : ℤ)
    · rw [wordPatch_of_mem _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
      congr 1
      omega
    · rw [wordPatch_of_not_mem _ _ _ (by omega), hb _ (by omega)]
      rcases (show p = -1 ∨ p = (w.length : ℤ) by omega) with rfl | rfl
      · rw [FinTM.bufferTape_left]
      · rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_length]
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := clearTM_run_ofCfg i w a rfl hw
  refine ⟨?_, h₂, h₃⟩
  rw [h₁]
  apply Cfg.ext <;> try rfl
  funext j q
  dsimp only [a]
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst j
    simp only [ite_true, true_and]
    by_cases hq : d.workTapePos i ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos i + (w.length : ℤ)
    · rw [if_pos hq]
    · rw [if_neg hq, wordPatch_of_not_mem _ _ _ hq, hb q (by omega)]
  · simp only [hj, false_and, ite_false]

/-! #### The clock writer and the runner on one phase host

The clock word is written field by field. In each of `c` passes, every field of the record is
copied onto the clock tape through the constant map, the record head skips to the next field,
the clock head skips past the written cells and steps back onto the clock's right delimiter,
where the next copy continues the word. Between passes the record head skips back over the
fields. All phases, the windowed runner, the clear of the clock and the exits run on one phase
host. -/

/-- The host's phases. In pass `p`, field `j` takes four phases: the constant copy onto the
clock, the skip past the field on the record tape, the skip past the written cells on the
clock, and the one-cell move back onto the clock's delimiter. After a pass the record head
skips back field by field. After the last pass the clock head returns to the clock's first
cell in two phases; then come the windowed runner, the clear of the clock after a `halted` or
`left` exit, and the exits. -/
private inductive cw_Idx (c m : ℕ) where
  /-- the constant copy of field `j` onto the clock, in pass `p` -/
  | copy (p : Fin c) (j : Fin m)
  /-- the skip past field `j` on the record tape -/
  | skipS (p : Fin c) (j : Fin m)
  /-- the skip past the written cells on the clock, after field `j` of pass `p`, or after the
  last pass (`none`) the step past the clock's right delimiter -/
  | skipC (o : Option (Fin c × Fin m))
  /-- the one-cell move back onto the clock's right delimiter -/
  | left (p : Fin c) (j : Fin m)
  /-- the skip back over field `j` on the record tape -/
  | back (p : Fin c) (j : Fin m)
  /-- the skip back over the clock word -/
  | clockBack
  /-- the windowed runner -/
  | run
  /-- the clear of the clock after a `halted` (`true`) or `left` (`false`) exit -/
  | clear (b : Bool)
  /-- the stationary exits -/
  | stop
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- Each phase's controls: its row's, the runner's, and the exits. -/
private def cw_Ctrl (P : Type) {c m : ℕ} : cw_Idx c m → Type
  | .copy _ _ => SweepPhase
  | .skipS _ _ => SeekPhase
  | .skipC _ => SeekPhase
  | .left _ _ => Bool
  | .back _ _ => SeekPhase
  | .clockBack => SeekPhase
  | .run => P
  | .clear _ => SweepPhase
  | .stop => WindowExit

/-- The controls are finite. The three exits are listed here, since `Turing.WindowExit` has
no public `Fintype` instance. -/
private instance cw_Ctrl_fintype (P : Type) [Fintype P] {c m : ℕ} (i : cw_Idx c m) :
    Fintype (cw_Ctrl P i) := by
  cases i <;> dsimp only [cw_Ctrl] <;> first
    | infer_instance
    | exact ⟨{.halted, .left, .exhausted}, fun y => by cases y <;> simp⟩

/-- The controls have decidable equality. -/
private instance cw_Ctrl_decidableEq (P : Type) [DecidableEq P] {c m : ℕ} (i : cw_Idx c m) :
    DecidableEq (cw_Ctrl P i) := by
  cases i <;> dsimp only [cw_Ctrl] <;> infer_instance

/-- The phase machines: the writer's rows on the record tape `0` and the clock tape
`Fin.last (K + 1)`, the windowed runner `R`, the clear, and stationary exits. -/
private def cw_rows {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} (e : Γ) (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) {c m : ℕ} :
    (i : cw_Idx c m) → MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ (cw_Ctrl P i)
  | .copy _ _ => copyMapTM (K + 2) 0 (Fin.last (K + 1)) (fun _ => ()) (fun _ _ => e)
  | .skipS _ _ => skipTM (K + 2) 0
  | .skipC _ => skipTM (K + 2) (Fin.last (K + 1))
  | .left _ _ => cw_leftTM (K + 2) (Fin.last (K + 1))
  | .back _ _ => skipBackTM (K + 2) 0
  | .clockBack => skipBackTM (K + 2) (Fin.last (K + 1))
  | .run => R
  | .clear _ => clearTM (K + 2) (Fin.last (K + 1))
  | .stop => ⟨WindowExit.exhausted, fun q _ _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some q⟩⟩

/-- The phase after field `j`'s round: the next field's copy, or after the last field the
record's rewind. -/
private def cw_next {P : Type} {c m : ℕ} (p : Fin c) (j : Fin m) :
    Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i :=
  if h : j.val + 1 < m then ⟨.copy p ⟨j.val + 1, h⟩, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩
  else ⟨.back p j, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩

/-- The phase after the skip back over field `j`: the skip back over the previous field, or
after the first field the next pass, or after the last pass the clock's rewind. -/
private def cw_prev {P : Type} {c m : ℕ} (p : Fin c) (j : Fin m) :
    Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i :=
  if 0 < j.val then
    ⟨.back p ⟨j.val - 1, (Nat.sub_le _ _).trans_lt j.isLt⟩, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩
  else if h : p.val + 1 < c then
    ⟨.copy ⟨p.val + 1, h⟩ ⟨0, j.pos⟩, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩
  else ⟨.skipC none, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩

/-- The phase after the skip on the clock: the move back onto the clock's delimiter after a
field, or the skip back over the clock word after the last pass. -/
private def cw_afterSkip {P : Type} {c m : ℕ} :
    Option (Fin c × Fin m) → Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i
  | some (p, j) => ⟨.left p j, false⟩
  | none => ⟨.clockBack, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩

/-- The redirect table. The writer's phases follow one another at their rows' `done` anchors
(the one-cell move at `true`); the runner's `halted` and `left` exits enter the clear and its
`exhausted` exit stops; the clear stops with the runner's exit. -/
private def cw_red {P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} :
    (i : cw_Idx c m) → cw_Ctrl P i → Option (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i)
  | .copy p j, q =>
    if q = SweepPhase.done then some ⟨.skipS p j, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ else none
  | .skipS p j, q =>
    if q = SeekPhase.done then some ⟨.skipC (some (p, j)), (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ else none
  | .skipC o, q => if q = SeekPhase.done then some (cw_afterSkip o) else none
  | .left p j, q => if q = true then some (cw_next p j) else none
  | .back p j, q => if q = SeekPhase.done then some (cw_prev p j) else none
  | .clockBack, q => if q = SeekPhase.done then some ⟨.run, en⟩ else none
  | .run, q =>
    if q = ex .halted then some ⟨.clear true, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩
    else if q = ex .left then some ⟨.clear false, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩
    else if q = ex .exhausted then some ⟨.stop, (WindowExit.exhausted : WindowExit)⟩
    else none
  | .clear b, q =>
    if q = SweepPhase.done then
      some ⟨.stop, (if b then .halted else .left : WindowExit)⟩
    else none
  | .stop, _ => none

/-- The configuration-count runner's machine: the phase host over `cw_rows` and `cw_red`. Its
initial control is never used: the runner is started at the first copy's control. -/
private def cw_hostTM {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) (c m : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) :=
  phaseHostTM (cw_rows e R) ⟨.stop, (WindowExit.exhausted : WindowExit)⟩ (cw_red en ex)

/-- The writer's configurations: the start configuration `d` with control `q`, the record
head moved by `a`, the clock head by `b`, and `n` copies of `e` patched onto the clock tape at
the clock's start. -/
private def cw_cfg {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ) (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x)
    (q : S) (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) : Cfg (K + 2) Γ S x :=
  ⟨some q, d.inputPos,
    fun j z => if j = Fin.last (K + 1) then
      wordPatch (d.workTapes j) (d.workTapePos j) (List.replicate n e) z else d.workTapes j z,
    fun j => if j = 0 then d.workTapePos j + a
      else if j = Fin.last (K + 1) then d.workTapePos j + b else d.workTapePos j,
    d.output⟩

/-- The record tape and the clock tape are distinct. -/
private lemma cw_zero_ne_last (K : ℕ) : (0 : Fin (K + 2)) ≠ Fin.last (K + 1) := by
  intro h
  have h' := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_last] at h'
  omega


/-- The clock tape of a writer configuration is the constant patch. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_clockTape {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (q : S) (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) :
    (cw_cfg e d q a n b).workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) =
      wordPatch (d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1))) (d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)))
        (List.replicate n e) :=
  funext fun _ => if_pos rfl

/-- A clock cell of a writer configuration. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_clock {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (q : S) (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (z : ℤ) :
    (cw_cfg e d q a n b).workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z =
      if d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) + n
        then some e else d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z := by
  rw [cw_cfg_clockTape, cw_patch_rep]

/-- The other tapes of a writer configuration are the start configuration's. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_tape {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (q : S) (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (j : Fin (K + 2))
    (hj : j ≠ Fin.last (K + 1)) (z : ℤ) :
    (cw_cfg e d q a n b).workTapes j z = d.workTapes j z :=
  if_neg hj

/-- The record head of a writer configuration. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_pos₀ {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (q : S) (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) :
    (cw_cfg e d q a n b).workTapePos 0 = d.workTapePos 0 + a := by
  dsimp only [cw_cfg]
  rw [if_pos rfl]

/-- The clock head of a writer configuration. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_posL {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (q : S) (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) :
    (cw_cfg e d q a n b).workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) =
      d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) + b := by
  dsimp only [cw_cfg]
  rw [if_neg (cw_zero_ne_last K).symm, if_pos rfl]

/-- The other heads of a writer configuration are the start configuration's. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_pos {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (q : S) (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (j : Fin (K + 2)) (h₀ : j ≠ 0)
    (hL : j ≠ Fin.last (K + 1)) :
    (cw_cfg e d q a n b).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j := by
  dsimp only [cw_cfg]
  rw [if_neg h₀, if_neg hL]

/-- Renaming the control keeps the heads. -/
private lemma cw_mapState_pos {k : ℕ} {Γ S S' : Type} {x : List Γ} (f : S → S')
    (a : Cfg k Γ S x) : (a.mapState f).workTapePos = a.workTapePos :=
  funext (Cfg.mapState_workTapePos f a)

/-- Renaming the control keeps the tapes. -/
private lemma cw_mapState_tapes {k : ℕ} {Γ S S' : Type} {x : List Γ} (f : S → S')
    (a : Cfg k Γ S x) : (a.mapState f).workTapes = a.workTapes :=
  funext fun j => funext (Cfg.mapState_workTapes f a j)

/-- Renaming the control keeps the input position and the output. -/
private lemma cw_mapState_io {k : ℕ} {Γ S S' : Type} {x : List Γ} (f : S → S')
    (a : Cfg k Γ S x) : (a.mapState f).inputPos = a.inputPos ∧ (a.mapState f).output = a.output :=
  ⟨Cfg.mapState_inputPos f a, Cfg.mapState_output f a⟩

/-- Renaming the control of a writer configuration. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_mapState {K : ℕ} {Γ P S S' : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (q : S) (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (f : S → S') :
    (cw_cfg e d q a n b).mapState f = cw_cfg e d (f q) a n b := by
  refine Cfg.ext ?_ (cw_mapState_io f _).1 (cw_mapState_tapes f _) (cw_mapState_pos f _)
    (cw_mapState_io f _).2
  rw [Cfg.mapState_state]
  rfl

/-- A writer configuration with both heads at the start has the start's heads. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_pos_zero {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (q : S) (n : ℕ) :
    (cw_cfg e d q 0 n 0).workTapePos = d.workTapePos := by
  funext j
  by_cases h₀ : j = 0
  · subst h₀
    rw [cw_cfg_pos₀, add_zero]
  · by_cases hL : j = Fin.last (K + 1)
    · subst hL
      rw [cw_cfg_posL, add_zero]
    · exact cw_cfg_pos e d q 0 n 0 j h₀ hL

/-- With nothing moved or written, a writer configuration is its start configuration. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_zero {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ) (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x)
    (q : P) (hd : d.state = some q) : cw_cfg e d q 0 0 0 = d := by
  refine Cfg.ext hd.symm rfl ?_ (cw_cfg_pos_zero e d q 0) rfl
  funext j z
  by_cases hj : j = Fin.last (K + 1)
  · subst hj
    rw [cw_cfg_clock, if_neg (by push_cast; omega)]
  · exact cw_cfg_tape e d q 0 0 0 j hj z

/-- Moving the record head of a writer configuration and renaming its control. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_move₀ {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (q q' : S) (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b v a' : ℤ)
    (hv : v = d.workTapePos 0 + a') :
    ({ cw_cfg e d q a n b with
        state := some q'
        workTapePos := Function.update (cw_cfg e d q a n b).workTapePos 0 v } :
        Cfg (K + 2) Γ S x) = cw_cfg e d q' a' n b := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl rfl ?_ rfl
  funext j
  dsimp only
  by_cases h₀ : j = 0
  · subst h₀
    rw [Function.update_self, hv, cw_cfg_pos₀]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne h₀]
    dsimp only [cw_cfg]
    rw [if_neg h₀, if_neg h₀]

/-- Moving the clock head of a writer configuration and renaming its control. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_moveL {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (q q' : S) (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b v b' : ℤ)
    (hv : v = d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) + b') :
    ({ cw_cfg e d q a n b with
        state := some q'
        workTapePos := Function.update (cw_cfg e d q a n b).workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) v } :
        Cfg (K + 2) Γ S x) = cw_cfg e d q' a n b' := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl rfl ?_ rfl
  funext j
  dsimp only
  by_cases hL : j = Fin.last (K + 1)
  · subst hL
    rw [Function.update_self, hv, cw_cfg_posL]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne hL]
    by_cases h₀ : j = 0
    · subst h₀
      rw [cw_cfg_pos₀, cw_cfg_pos₀]
    · rw [cw_cfg_pos e d q a n b j h₀ hL, cw_cfg_pos e d q' a n b' j h₀ hL]

/-- Every head within `r` cells of its position in `o`. -/
private def cw_box {k : ℕ} (o : Fin k → ℤ) (r : ℕ) (pos : Fin k → ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, |pos j - o j| ≤ (r : ℤ)

/-- The box from the record and clock heads' ranges, with every other head fixed. -/
private lemma cw_box_of {K : ℕ} (o pos : Fin (K + 2) → ℤ) (r : ℕ) (lo₀ hi₀ loL hiL : ℤ)
    (h₀ : o 0 + lo₀ ≤ pos 0 ∧ pos 0 ≤ o 0 + hi₀)
    (hL : o (Fin.last (K + 1)) + loL ≤ pos (Fin.last (K + 1)) ∧
      pos (Fin.last (K + 1)) ≤ o (Fin.last (K + 1)) + hiL)
    (ho : ∀ j, j ≠ 0 → j ≠ Fin.last (K + 1) → pos j = o j)
    (hr : -(r : ℤ) ≤ lo₀ ∧ hi₀ ≤ r ∧ -(r : ℤ) ≤ loL ∧ hiL ≤ r) : cw_box o r pos := by
  intro j
  rw [abs_le]
  by_cases hj₀ : j = 0
  · subst hj₀
    omega
  · by_cases hjL : j = Fin.last (K + 1)
    · subst hjL
      omega
    · rw [ho j hj₀ hjL]
      omega

/-- The box from one row's head range: the head of tape `i` within `[lo i, hi i]` and every
other head at its start, where it lies in the box. -/
private lemma cw_box_row {k : ℕ} (o start pos lo hi : Fin k → ℤ) (r : ℕ) (i : Fin k)
    (h : ∀ j, if j = i then pos j ∈ Finset.Icc (lo j) (hi j) else pos j = start j)
    (hrange : o i - r ≤ lo i ∧ hi i ≤ o i + r)
    (hstart : ∀ j, |start j - o j| ≤ (r : ℤ)) : cw_box o r pos := by
  intro j
  have hj := h j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst hji
    rw [if_pos rfl, Finset.mem_Icc] at hj
    rw [abs_le]
    omega
  · rw [if_neg hji] at hj
    rw [hj]
    exact hstart j

/-- A writer configuration whose heads are moved by at most `r` lies in the box. -/
private lemma cw_cfg_box {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ) (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x)
    (q : S) (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (r : ℕ) (ha : |a| ≤ r) (hb : |b| ≤ r) :
    cw_box d.workTapePos r (cw_cfg e d q a n b).workTapePos := by
  intro j
  by_cases h₀ : j = 0
  · subst h₀
    rw [cw_cfg_pos₀, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact ha
  · by_cases hL : j = Fin.last (K + 1)
    · subst hL
      rw [cw_cfg_posL, add_sub_cancel_left]
      exact hb
    · rw [cw_cfg_pos e d q a n b j h₀ hL, sub_self, abs_zero]
      positivity

/-- A phase redirected only at `v`, which its row avoids before `t`, is never redirected
before `t`. -/
private lemma cw_guard {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (i : cw_Idx c m)
    {x : List Γ} (a : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (cw_Ctrl P i) x) (t : ℕ) (v : cw_Ctrl P i)
    (hcut : ∀ u < t, ((cw_rows e R i).runFrom a u).state ≠ some v)
    (hnone : ∀ z, z ≠ v → cw_red en ex i z = none) :
    ∀ u < t, ∀ z, ((cw_rows e R i).runFrom a u).state = some z → cw_red en ex i z = none :=
  fun u hu z hz => hnone z fun h => hcut u hu (h ▸ hz)

/-- **One phase as a host segment.** A phase other than the exits, run from `a` to `b` and
dispatched by the redirect table, is a segment of the host that avoids the exits, and its head
relation holds through the dispatch.
**Proof sketch.** The phase lemma of the phase host gives the tagged prefix and the dispatch;
a tagged control is never an exit's, and the dispatch keeps the heads. -/
